compound: sukha-vardhana; describes the effect of the recited names

items.question: What beneficial effects result from reciting the hundred-and-eight divine names?
premises: The recited names destroy suffering, poverty, and misfortune.
The recited names bring about an increase in happiness.
These paired effects characterize the power of the divine names.
items.inference: Recitation of the divine names removes afflictions and promotes well-being.
items.plain_english: It destroys suffering, poverty, and misfortune, and increases happiness.
